time_expired_analysis.inference: Significant share of net R comes from time-expired exits. A binary target/stop formulation mismodels this contribution, proving necessity of three-outcome (p_T, p_S, p_E) model.

dual_win_definition.explanation: Target-hit rate reflects setups reaching +4 ATR without hitting stop. Profitable-trade rate includes setups exiting on Day 10 above entry after statutory costs.
